abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Highlord of the Tal'darim
abilities.text: Calculate the total lost Supply of all Friendly Units (a Unit's lost Supply is its Initial Supply Value minus its Current Supply Value). While this total is: 2 or more: When this Unit resolves IMPACT, it generates 3 additional IMPACT dice. 4 or more: This Unit's weapons gain INSTANT. 6 or more: This Unit's abilities are Empowered.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.text: When this Unit receives Damage, target another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8″. The targeted Unit suffers 2 Damage, and the Damage received by this Unit is reduced by 2 (when Empowered, reduced by 3).

abilities.name: Wrath of the Highlord
abilities.text: Target another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8″. The targeted Unit suffers 2 Damage, and this Unit performs a 4″ Run Action (when Empowered, perform a 6″ Run Action).

abilities.name: Destruction Wave
abilities.text: Target another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8″. The targeted Friendly Unit suffers 2 Damage. Then target an Enemy Unit Within 8″ of this Unit. The targeted Enemy Unit suffers HITS 4 (1) (when Empowered, HITS 6 (1)).

abilities.name: Empower Me
abilities.text: Target another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8″. The targeted Unit suffers 2 Damage, and this Unit's Bane Blades gain BUFF RoA (4) (when Empowered, BUFF RoA (6)).

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (6) 4+ effect.
